strings.(애써 지은 미소 뒤에 왠지 모르게 슬픈 느낌이 든다. 그런 느낌을 지우: (There is something sad behind her forced smile. As if trying to dispel that feeling, the magic golem Madori fidgets on Narsha's shoulder.)
Madori, you're such a good friend…. Just like Anise and Ambrosia.
strings.(마도리가 나르샤의 의중을 읽었는지 움직임을 멈춘다.): (As if sensing Narsha's feelings, Madori stops moving.)
I lied. I haven't been all right.
strings.마법청에서 수상한 사람이 와서 마도리를 회수하겠다고 했어요. 싫다고, 그: A suspicious man from the Magic Bureau came and said he was taking Madori back. I refused and asked who had ordered it, but he couldn't answer.
But the Magic Bureau told you to be Madori's owner.
strings.네, 맞아요. 강제로 빼앗으려고 해서 소리를 질렀더니 다행스럽게 젤릭과: Yes, that's right. He tried to take Madori by force, so I screamed. Luckily, Jelic and Raclette came over and chased him away.
strings.처음엔 마도리가 신기해서 마법청 핑계를 대는 줄 알았는데, 그게 아니었어: At first, I thought he was just using the Magic Bureau as an excuse because he was fascinated by Madori. But that wasn't it. He's already come three times, pretending to be someone else, and tried to take Madori….
strings.아인스트 씨도, 젤릭과 라클렛도, 총장님도 그런 사람이 보이면 붙잡겠다고: Einst, Jelic, Raclette, and the President all said they'd catch him if they saw him, but he always disappears right away….
strings.무서웠어요. 처음엔 다른 사람처럼 보이더니 손을 뻗을 땐 같은 사람이었거: I was frightened. He looked like a different person at first, but when he reached out, he was the same man. That man….
strings.네, 남자…. 큰 지팡이를 들고 있어서 마법사인 줄 알았는데, 주술사에: Yes, a man…. He was carrying a large staff, so I thought he was a mage, but he seemed more like a shaman….
strings.그래서 요즘 좀 무서워요. 어딜 가지도 못하고 여기에만 있어요. 꼭 마도: So I've been scared lately. I can't go anywhere. I just stay here. It feels as though he's after me, not Madori….
He had ears like mine. His arms weren't like mine, though…. And he didn't have a tail, so I couldn't quite call him beastfolk….
strings.아는 게 있으시면 말씀해주시겠어요? 혹시 그 사람은 칼리 족인가요? 모험: If you know something, could you please tell me? Is he a member of the Kali tribe? Like those people you know…?
I haven't seen him myself, so it's hard to say.
I know it's a lot to ask, but could you take me to see them?
strings.죄송해요…. 제가 너무 제 생각만 했어요…: I'm sorry…. I was only thinking of myself….
No, I'm sorry. I'm sorry I couldn't comfort you. Oh, that reminds me.
strings.제가 만난 정령왕께서 다음에 만나게 될 사람에게 정령의 가호가 있을 거라: The Spirit King I met asked me to tell the next person I met that they would have the spirits' blessing.
strings.고마워요. 정령의 가호라니…. 어?: Thank you. The spirits' blessing…. Huh?
strings.정확히는 모르겠지만, 갑자기 기분이 좋아졌어요. 시원한 얼음물을 마신 듯: I'm not sure why, but I suddenly feel better. It's like drinking a glass of ice-cold water.
strings.(기분 탓인가? 나르샤의 표정이 좋아진 것 같은데….): (Is it just my imagination? Narsha looks happier….)
Hi, Narsha. Hello, %s. I've been looking for you.
strings.젤릭, 오랜만이에요. 찾고 있었다고요?: Jelic, it's been a while. You were looking for me?
strings.일단 케이크 먼저 드실래요? 나르샤를 위해서 잔뜩 만들었거든요. 라클렛이: Would you like some cake first? I made lots for Narsha. Raclette told me not to make too much, but I couldn't help it.
Mmm, the cakes and cookies are delicious, but I've been eating so many lately….
Still, I'll have some. You made it for me, after all, and I was just getting hungry….
You can look forward to dinner too.
strings.이번엔 무슨 맛이에요? 전과 맛이 조금 다른데…. 아, 이게 중요한 게: What flavor is this one? It tastes a little different…. Oh, that's not what matters right now. Why were you looking for me?
strings.잠시 저쪽에서 드릴 말씀이 있어요. 나르샤, 내가 모험가님을 모셔가도 괜: I'd like to speak with you over there for a moment. Narsha, may I borrow the adventurer?
strings.네, 괜찮아요. 그나저나 모험가님, 이야기를 들어주셔서 기분이 좋아졌어요: Yes, of course. And Adventurer, I feel better now that you've listened to me.
That's good. In that case, I'll leave you some of Jelic's handmade Madori jellies too.
Now, Adventurer. Let's go see Raclette.
strings.마도리, 너도 기운이 넘치는 게 느껴지지? 이상하네. 왜 그럴까?: Madori, you feel full of energy too, don't you? How strange. Why is that?
strings.젤릭, 케이크라면 맛없어. 아니, 못 먹어. 들고 돌아가. 지겨워, 안: Jelic, if that's cake, it's awful. I mean, I can't eat it. Take it back. I'm sick of it. I already eat it every single day….
Jelic brought me this time, instead of cake.
Oh, it's you, %s. Jelic must have brought you here about that matter.
Yes, the suspicious person who was after her recently.
I hear he's come and gone three times already.
strings.길드 연합 에스닐 중심부에는 수상한 사람들이 들어올 수 없도록 경계가 삼: Security in the heart of Guild Union Esnil is tight, to keep suspicious people out.
strings.데이나 총장이 있기에 실바리아 제국의 의회나 황궁에서 일하는 사람들도 허: With President Dayna here, even people working for the Silvaria Empire's parliament or imperial palace need permission to enter.
There are also barriers the guild mages have put up, some more noticeable than others….
strings.그런 결계와 길드연합 가드와 수많은 실력자들의 눈을 피해 들어왔다는 건…: To slip past those barriers, the Guild Union guards, and so many skilled people….
He clearly isn't an ordinary person.
strings.지금까지 모은 정보는 나르샤와 비슷한 귀, 주술사, 그리고 엘 아노르 평: All we've learned so far is that he has ears like Narsha's, seems to be a shaman, and appeared in the El Anor Plains.
strings.가드와 문라이트 일원들이 평원을 찾고 있지만, 그 외에는 마땅한 단서가: The guards and members of Moonlight are searching the plains, but we have no other useful leads.
strings.그래서 말인데, 오신 김에 잠깐 도와주셨으면 해요. 나르샤의 마도골렘은: So, since you're here, we'd like your help for a little while. Narsha's magic golem came from the Magic Bureau….
If this is connected to people or incidents involving the bureau, it could become a serious problem.
strings.(큰일이라…. 그런 일들이 모이면 이리스를 위험하게 만드는 일이겠지?): (A serious problem…. If enough of those pile up, Iris could be in danger, couldn't she?)
strings.(문득 메디아 님 말씀이 떠오르네. 운명에 이끌리듯 끝에 다가가면 답이: (That reminds me of what Medea said. If I follow where fate leads me, I may find my answer at the end….)
strings.(그러네. 어쩌다 보니 여기까지 왔으니….): (That's true. Somehow, I've ended up here….)
strings.무슨 생각을 그렇게 하시나요?: What's got you thinking so hard?
strings.아무것도 아니에요. 그러면 제가 뭘 도와드리면 될까요?: Oh, nothing. What would you like me to do?
strings.저희는 저희대로 평원 동부와 남부, 산악지대를 돌아볼 테니 평원 서부에서: We'll search the eastern and southern plains and the mountains. Could you look for anything unusual in the western plains?
You might be able to see something we can't, %s.
strings.길드에서 정식으로 의뢰하는 거니 보수가 제대로 지급 될 거예요. 일단 제: This is an official guild request, so you'll be properly paid. For now, take some of my cake….
Jelic, put that away. Don't give it to %s. Leave it here.
strings.어디서 그렇게 케이크가 나오는 건가요?: Where does all that cake come from?
Hehe. An elf's pocket is a magic pocket.
strings.젤릭에게 디저트나 케이크 이야기를 꺼내면 끝도 없으니 그만하시죠. 이제: If you get Jelic started on desserts or cake, we'll never hear the end of it. Please begin your search.
It's quite a way to the western plains, so I'll head out first.
Just have a look around and come back. Jelic, let's go too.
Jelic, stop. Don't pack cake to eat on the way. No pudding either.
strings.(코볼트 근위부대가 있던 엘 아노르 평원 서부, 한적해 보이는 곳에 %s: (In a quiet part of the western El Anor Plains where the kobold royal guards once stood, %s comes to a halt.)
strings.여기에 이런 길이 있었구나. 크노소스로 가는 길?: I didn't know there was a road here. Does it lead to Knossos?
strings.(공격하려는 의도는 없어 보이지만 그래도 조심해야 해.): (They don't seem to intend to attack, but I still need to be careful.)
Passage through this area is forbidden by decree of the Silvaria Empire…. You are….
strings.(길 안쪽에서 낯익은 사람이 나타나 길을 가로막는다.): (A familiar figure emerges from farther down the road and blocks the way.)
strings.아르젠트가 여기엔 왜 있죠?: Argent? What are you doing here?
strings.제가 드리고 싶은 말입니다. %s 님께선 무슨 일로 오셨습니까? 공무방해: I was about to ask you the same thing. What brings you here, %s? You may be interfering with official duties….
strings.(방금 그 느낌은 아르젠트가 아니야. 메디아 님 대신 나타났던 그 여자의: (What I felt just now wasn't Argent. It was definitely like the presence of that woman who appeared in Medea's place.)
strings.기분 탓인 것 같아요. 길드 연합 사람에게 난처한 일이 생겨서 뭘 좀 찾: It must be my imagination. Someone at the Guild Union is in a difficult situation, so I was looking for something.
A Guild Union matter? You may tell me about it.
strings.(아르젠트에게 수상한 사람의 흔적을 찾고 있다고 간단하게 전한다.): (I briefly tell Argent that I'm searching for traces of a suspicious person.)
strings.나르샤라는 소녀에게 그런 일이 있었습니까?: So that happened to a girl named Narsha?
Someone who looks like a shaman, with animal ears….
strings.크노소스 가도 안에 있는 유격병들에게 물어보겠습니다. 잠시만 기다리시기: I will ask the rangers stationed along Knossos Road. Please wait a moment.
strings.(아르젠트가 말이 끝나자마자 가도 안으로 들어간다.): (As soon as he finishes speaking, Argent heads down the road.)
strings.여기 아르젠트와 유격병이 있다는 건 제국의 땅이라는 건가? 아직 평원에: If Argent and the rangers are here, does that mean this is imperial territory? They still seem busy enough with the kobolds on the plains….
strings.(잠시 후, 아르젠트가 미심쩍은 표정을 지으며 걸어 나온다.): (A little later, Argent returns with a doubtful expression.)
strings.%s 님께서 말씀하신 인상착의와 비슷한 인물이 있습니다. 하지만, 한달: There is someone who matches your description, %s. However, I am told he has been with the rangers almost constantly for the entire month and hasn't come outside.
strings.크노소스 지역은 오랫동안 제국이 지켜보는 장소입니다. 수인들의 위협에 대: The empire has kept watch over Knossos for a long time. It occupied the area on the pretext of defending against the beastfolk. Now, even the beastfolk have abandoned it.
strings.그래서 수인들이 다른 곳으로 가려면 실바리아 제국 유격병 초소에서 허락을: As a result, beastfolk must obtain permission from a Silvaria Empire ranger outpost before traveling elsewhere.
I am not in charge here, so that is all I can tell you. Even you do not currently have permission to enter, %s.
strings.제국의 허가가 있어야 한다는 거죠?: I need the empire's permission, then?
strings.그렇습니다. 일단은 돌아가셔서 그렇게만 전해주셨으면 합니다. 그리고 허가: Correct. For now, please return and tell them what I've told you. I will put in a request for your permission to enter.
strings.알겠어요. 그런데 아르젠트는 여기 무슨 일로 온 거예요?: All right. But what brings you here, Argent?
Parliamentary business. I'm sorry, but I cannot discuss it.
That's all right. I'll be going, then. Thank you.
strings.(크노소스가 제국 관련 장소니 데이나 씨한테 말하는 게 좋겠지?): (Since Knossos is connected to the empire, I should tell Dayna, shouldn't I?)
strings.(마법청 인간들을 조사해야겠군….): (I should investigate the people at the Magic Bureau….)
Yes. I stayed here to wait for you, %s.
Raclette and Jelic returned from their patrol, but they didn't find much.
I didn't find any trace of the suspicious person, but Argent helped me.
Argent was there? Never mind, go on.
strings.아트젠트가 유격병 초소에 물어봤는데, 밖으로 나온 수인은 없었다고 했어요: Argent asked at the ranger outpost, but they said none of the beastfolk had come outside.
strings.맞아. 그곳에 있는 수인들은 항상 이동할 때, 초소에서 허가를 받아야 해: That's right. The beastfolk there always need permission from the outpost to travel, even when they're going into their own territory….
I felt as though someone was watching me there.
strings.흠…. 누군가라고 하면 잘 모르겠으니까 %s 씨의 경험 중에 어떤 상황이: Hmm…. "Someone" doesn't tell me much. Can you compare it to a situation or a person you've encountered before, %s?
I think it was that woman….
strings.그런데 또 달라요. 정확히 말하면 그 느낌이지만 그 여잔 아니었어요. 다: But it was different too. To be precise, it felt like her, but it wasn't her. It seemed to be someone else….
strings.미안해. 마녀에 대한 정보가 별로 없어. 수인 제국 영토에 가본 적이 없: I'm sorry. I don't have much information about the witch. I've never been to the beastfolk empire's territory. I've had no reason to go. I haven't, at least….
strings.그리고 %s씨에게 물어볼게 있어. 나르샤를 찾아온 건 결코 우연이 아니지: And there's something I want to ask you, %s. Your visit to Narsha wasn't a coincidence, was it?
strings.(답을 찾는 과정을 알아차린 데이나에게 메디아의 이야기를 꺼낸다.): (Since Dayna has noticed my search for answers, I tell her about Medea.)
strings.초인 메디아…. 안 그래도 어떤 사람인지 궁금했는데, 그런 고통의 운명을: Medea, the Champion…. I was curious about what sort of person she was. To think she bears such a painful fate….
My sister and I also need to resolve that problem, so I think it will tie into her decision.
strings.그리고 요즘 이스트랜드의 이면이 엄청나게 커지고 있어. 아마도 그날을 기: And Eastland's other side has been growing enormously lately. It must be the work of the one waiting for that day.
strings.나르샤를 신경 써줘서 고마워. 그 수상한 존재에 대해선 좀 더 내가 알아: Thank you for looking out for Narsha. I'll investigate that suspicious person further.
If you're handling it, I'm sure things will be all right. Thank you.
strings.혹시 전하실 말씀은 없으세요?: Is there anything you'd like me to pass along?
strings.언젠가 제이드가 마법학원 제레니스에서 학원제 초기 내용을 기록한 책을 봤: Jade once mentioned seeing a book at Xerenis Magic Academy that recorded the early days of its festival. If you find it and give it to her, she may learn something.
The festival is named Daphne, after all….
All right. I'll take it to her. See you later, Dayna.
You've returned. I've been waiting for you.
You must be tired. Some tea…. No, I'll stop serving that tea now. I'll bring you something else.
Thank you for willingly setting out on this journey for me.
Now, would you tell me what happened?
Of course. I'll start with my visit to Noel.
strings.(메디아에게 노엘과 티티, 나린, 그리고 나르샤를 만나고 수상한 남자의: (I tell Medea about meeting Noel, Titi, Narin, and Narsha, and about following the suspicious man's trail.)
You've been through a great deal.
And I have something for you. This book.
strings.데이나 씨가 마법학원 제레니스에서 열리는 학원제 관련 책에 대한 정보를: Dayna told me about a book on the festival held at Xerenis Magic Academy, so I found it and brought it here.
strings.마력이 담겨 있어서 그런가…. 글자 부분이 잘 안 보이더라구요. 메디아: Maybe it's because the book contains magic, but I couldn't make out the writing. You might be able to read it, Medea.
strings.(메디아에게 책을 받아들더니 천천히 살펴보기 시작한다.): (Medea takes the book and begins to examine it slowly.)
strings.학원제라 하면…. 혹시 어린 아이들이 가르침을 받는 그런 장소의 축제인가: An academy festival…. Is that a festival held at a place where children are taught?
Yes, an event at a school or somewhere like that.
strings.부럽군요. 프레이오스에는 이렇게 아이들이 가르침을 받고 즐길 수 있는 그: How enviable. Freios has places where children can learn and enjoy themselves….
strings.우리 칼리 족을 포함한 이스트랜드의 사람들에겐 그런 경험이 별로 없습니다: The people of Eastland, including our Kali tribe, have had few such experiences.
strings.오랜 분쟁과 전투, 그 속에 삶과 죽음을 마주한 사람들에겐 생존이 먼저였: For people who faced life and death amid long years of conflict and battle, survival came first.
strings.죄송합니다. 괜한 말을 했군요. 책을 조금만 더 살펴볼 테니, 기다려 주: Forgive me. There was no need to say that. Would you wait while I examine the book a little more? I don't know whether my magic will let me read its contents….
Thankfully, I can read it with my magic.
Take your time. I'll drink the tea you brought me.
The festival is named "Daphne"…? Her name….
strings.학원제가 황제의 왕림 시기에 맞춰서 시작되고 정착되던 시기에 이름이 붙여: The festival began to coincide with a visit from the emperor, and it received its name as it became an established event.
strings.저희 일족이 교단에게 쫓기고 사랑하던 땅을 벗어난 것이 딱 그 시기입니다: That was exactly when our tribe was pursued by the Order and driven from the land we loved.
strings.…마법을 배우는 훌륭한 학생들이 실력을 뽐내기 위해 마련된 자리, 학원제: …An academy festival, an occasion for gifted students of magic to show their skills….
strings.초기엔 사고가 잦았다고 적혀 있는데, 그 중 일부 학생들이 어떤 골렘에: It says there were many accidents in the early days. Among them were cases of students being killed or going missing because of a certain golem.
And the place where they went missing was Knossos Road….
Now I understand. Why I felt that way….
(Medea approaches the flower bed behind her and stares at a plant growing there. A moment later, a small flame rises from its roots and burns away every leaf and stem.)
I will never serve that tea again. That was the last plant….
And I may be going there myself before long.
